item.tib: bsngo ba yon bshad kyi rim pa phan bde'i rol mo
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni mchog sprul mkhan rin po che g.yung drung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dbang po'i zhal snga nas gsung bskul brtsal ba la brten nas/ gshen gyi drang srong dbra ston bskal (skal) bzang bstan rgyal gyis nyer mkhor bsdus shing brjod bde ba'i tshul gyis rang gnas sgrub sde byang chub gling du sbyar ba'o//
